Priority Finding: Naive league tables would send the business chasing noise.
Evidence: 314 segment cells scanned: 13 have raw p<0.05 vs 16 expected by chance; 0 survive FDR (min q=0.20). Chi-square p: issue 0.33, channel 0.27, region 0.69, product 0.79, source 0.82.
Recommended Action: Publish the KPI scorecard weekly from the warehouse views with 95% CIs; flag a segment as a hotspot only if it survives FDR; agree the proposed targets with stakeholders; show rank-stability next to any ranking.
Expected KPI Impact: Avoids mis-allocating budget to chance-driven 'hotspots'; no direct revenue claim

Priority Finding: Negative-sentiment cases are resolved about twice as slowly and are far less likely to buy again.
Evidence: Negative cases take 18.1h vs 9.1h (Cohen's d=1.90); 91% of negatives breach a 12h SLA; repeat purchase 28.2% (negative) vs 72.0% (positive) = 43.8pp gap (adjusted OR 0.17, 95% CI 0.13-0.22).
Recommended Action: Score every incoming comment with the NLP sentiment model; auto-route Negative to a priority queue with a 12h resolution SLA, a named owner and a recovery playbook (apology, proactive follow-up, goodwill credit). Run it as a randomised pilot (fast lane vs control) because the data are observational.
Expected KPI Impact: Recoverable revenue ₹162.2K / ₹405.4K / ₹810.9K (10% / 25% / 50% of the 44pp repeat gap closed)

Priority Finding: The data cannot show trends, emerging issues or customer-level behaviour.
Evidence: No date field (trend / 'emerging issue' / improvement tracking impossible); 89.5% of multi-record customers have >1 region and 100% have >1 revenue value; sentiment is not clustered within customers (ICC=-0.02); 113 records have Repeat_Purchase_Flag=1 with Order_Count=1; text is 100% templated.
Recommended Action: Add event timestamps (feedback, case open/close), a stable customer key and order IDs; define Repeat_Purchase_Flag (window, post-feedback); add issue reason codes; capture real free text.
Expected KPI Impact: Unlocks trend / early-warning KPIs and customer-level analytics (no direct revenue claim)

Priority Finding: Near-perfect scores reflect templated text; the model has no mechanism for unseen vocabulary.
Evidence: In-distribution accuracy 100% (CV) / 100% (hold-out); leave-one-descriptor-out accuracy 57.1% (= majority baseline 57.1%); generic VADER only 60.6% (8 of 19 opinion words score 0); on 30 hand-written natural sentences LR 70% / VADER 80% / hybrid 87% (indicative only).
Recommended Action: Collect >= 500 real comments labelled by humans for validation/retraining; adopt the hybrid (domain model + general lexicon) or a fine-tuned transformer; monitor vocabulary coverage and confidence.
Expected KPI Impact: Protects every downstream KPI that depends on sentiment (no direct revenue claim)

Priority Finding: Most of the revenue at risk is concentrated in a small, identifiable group: dissatisfied records in the top half of revenue.
Evidence: At-Risk segment (K-means k=3, silhouette 0.46, bootstrap ARI 0.99): 586 records, 94% negative. Critical tier (At-Risk x revenue Q3/Q4) = 306 records carrying ₹2.65M = 72% of all Revenue at Risk; 18.4h resolution, 29% repeat.
Recommended Action: Create a named outreach list from the Critical tier; contact within 24h; tiered goodwill offers by revenue band; track save-rate. Use the NLP + segmentation flags in the warehouse (fact_feedback_segment.risk_tier) as the list source.
Expected KPI Impact: Recoverable revenue about ₹290.0K (base: 25% of the repeat gap on this tier's revenue at risk); overlaps with R2 - do not add

Priority Finding: A quarter of records are satisfied, quickly resolved - and still never repeat-purchase.
Evidence: 'Satisfied Non-Repeaters' = 586 records (24.4%), CSAT 3.87, resolved in 8.8h, 0% repeat, revenue ₹3.70M. Conversion of 5% / 10% / 20% would add ₹185.2K / ₹370.4K / ₹740.7K.
Recommended Action: A/B test post-purchase offers and replenishment reminders on this segment; first validate the Repeat_Purchase_Flag definition (R3).

Priority Finding: These two topics lead the rankings but the gap to the average is statistically indistinguishable from chance.
Evidence: Negative rate Customer Support 28.7% and App Experience 26.2% vs 24.0% overall; issue-level chi-square p=0.33; rank #1 on Revenue at Risk in 43% / 37% of bootstrap resamples (chance 12.5%), top-3 in 86% / 83%.
Recommended Action: Read a stratified sample of negative texts per topic; run time-boxed fixes (support scripts, app checkout journey) with a pre-registered metric; do NOT re-allocate large budgets on the current ranking.
Expected KPI Impact: Excess negative revenue vs average about ₹129.8K - small and uncertain
